rule: 每句先定对象、条件和量词。先各一次支持、一次反证。条件未出现时，不把后果的反面写成整句错误；部分符合只在后果本身被直接读到时使用。excerpt 必须能在随后保存的正文里找到。

claims.object: 社会利益不缺乏，对象是 all。
claims.condition: 种族的全部生产力终于被放开并沿正常线路涌出。
claims.support_query: World Bank extreme poverty share declined 1990 to 2022
claims.counter_query: World Bank 713 million people in extreme poverty 2022

claims.object: 不再有生产者与消费者的划分、有闲阶级、工人阶级、资本与劳动的对阵。
claims.condition: 正确的经济信念和行动。
claims.support_query: sociologists argue class divisions producer consumer working class have weakened
claims.counter_query: ILO or OECD still classifies wage workers and capital labour distinction

claims.object: 社会疾病意义上的罪会自行退去。
claims.condition: 接受专门化服务这一正当关系之后。
claims.support_query: long-run decline in homicide and property crime rates worldwide
claims.counter_query: property crime and violence have not disappeared in high-income countries

claims.object: 针对财产的这一类罪完全消失。
claims.condition: 供给在先的正常分配，并教会人把行为当作回报。
claims.support_query: income support or guaranteed income effect on property crime
claims.counter_query: property crime remains common where basic income or welfare exists

claims.object: 那样长大的孩子和成人对偷窃没有理解。
claims.condition: 供给在先，从小被教成回报已经得到的东西。
claims.support_query: children with secure provision show no understanding of theft
claims.counter_query: theft and property offending among children in affluent households

claims.object: 社会疾病会像身体疾病一样因正当生活而自己消除。
claims.condition: 原因被除去之后的正当生活。作者写明不是一夜之间、也不是一切罪。
claims.support_query: WHO infectious disease deaths declined with sanitation and living conditions
claims.counter_query: WHO noncommunicable diseases remain leading causes of death 2019

claims.object: 同时改进个人、种族和两者的生产力。
claims.condition: 社会像明智的父母一样照顾所有儿童。
claims.support_query: universal early childhood provision effects on health and later earnings
claims.counter_query: universal child benefits do not by themselves raise population health and productivity together

claims.object: 正当行动的潮流建成健康的社会身体。
claims.condition: 所有人都在人类生活的有机产业里就位。If all。
claims.support_query: shift into formal employment associated with population health improvement
claims.counter_query: high employment countries still have large disease and poverty burdens

claims.object: 贫民窟的房屋、街道和店铺改造之后，反过来改变居民的性格。they 指房屋街道店铺。
claims.condition: 把贫民窟的身体重建到会持续作用于人。
claims.support_query: Moving to Opportunity housing relocation effects on adult and child outcomes
claims.counter_query: slum rehousing associated with weaker social ties or no character change
